sections.heading: Our Story
sections.body:
Healing Earth Design was founded on the belief that caring for our natural spaces can be a powerful form of healing.

After experiencing personal loss, I returned to school for sustainable horticulture and landscape design, finding peace and purpose through working with plants, soil, and seasonal rhythms. What began as a way to heal grew into a calling to help others reconnect with the earth in meaningful, practical ways.

sections.heading: Who I Am
sections.body:
I'm Sarah Martin, a sustainable horticulture and landscape design graduate with over six years of hands-on gardening experience. My yard serves as a trial garden where I test plants, observe ecosystems, and refine designs before bringing ideas to clients.

I specialize in plant-forward design—no hardscapes, no unnecessary complexity—just thoughtful, site-appropriate plantings that are beautiful, resilient, and supportive of local ecosystems.

sections.heading: My Approach
sections.body:
I believe in "right plant, right place." Every design begins with assessing the space, listening to the client, and what will thrive long-term.

Whether you're a beginner gardener or someone looking to deepen your connection to your outdoor space, I meet you where you are and help you grow with confidence.

sections.heading: Let's Work Together
sections.body:
Healing Earth Design serves homeowners who want gardens that feel alive, intentional, and grounded in sustainability.

If you're ready to create a garden that gives back to you and to the earth, I'd love to work with you.

data.body:
_Last updated October 9, 2026_

This policy explains what Healing Earth Design collects through this website and what happens to it.

## What I collect

When you send the contact form, I receive what you type into it: your name, your email address, the service you're interested in, a preferred date if you give one, your message, and which page you sent it from. Nothing else is collected about you on this site, and there is no advertising or tracking.

## How I use it

I use your details only to reply to you and to plan any work we agree on. I don't sell or share them with anyone, and I don't add you to a mailing list.

## Where it's kept

Form messages are stored in the content system that runs this website and are emailed to me. I keep them only as long as I need them to work with you, then delete them.

## Your choices

You can ask me at any time what I hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it. Send your request through the [contact page](/contact).

## Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted here with its date.

entries.title: Seasonal Annual Plantings for Lakefront Pots & Window Boxes

frontmatter.description: Enhancing a lakefront home with seasonal color through annual plantings that complement the surrounding landscape.
frontmatter.goal: To enhance a lakefront home with seasonal color through annual plantings that complemented the surrounding landscape and remained easy to maintain.
frontmatter.challenges: Wind exposure and fluctuating lakefront conditions. Containers requiring frequent watering. Desire for a cohesive look across multiple pots and window boxes.
frontmatter.solution: I designed coordinated annual plantings using resilient, sun-tolerant plants arranged with a balance of focal, filler, and trailing species. Plant selections emphasized durability, texture, and color harmony while keeping care requirements realistic.
frontmatter.outcome: The finished pots and window boxes provided vibrant color and movement throughout the season, enhancing the home's connection to the lake while remaining manageable for the homeowner.

seo.meta_title: Seasonal Annual Plantings for Lakefront Pots & Window Boxes | Healing Earth Design
seo.meta_description: Enhancing a lakefront home with seasonal color through annual plantings that complement the surrounding landscape.

frontmatter.description: A compact, functional herb garden supporting medicinal and culinary use while showcasing varied growing conditions in a small space.
frontmatter.goal: To create a compact, functional herb garden that supports medicinal and culinary use while showcasing a variety of growing conditions in a small space.
frontmatter.challenges: Limited footprint. Need for varied moisture and sun conditions. Desire for both beauty and practicality.
frontmatter.solution: I designed and installed a traditional herb spiral, creating multiple microclimates within a single structure. Drought-tolerant herbs were placed higher on the spiral, while moisture-loving plants were positioned toward the base. Plant choices were guided by medicinal use, growth habits, and site conditions.
frontmatter.outcome: The herb spiral became a highly productive and visually engaging garden feature, providing fresh medicinal and culinary herbs throughout the growing season while serving as an educational example of ecological garden design.

seo.meta_title: Medicinal Herb Spiral Garden | Healing Earth Design
seo.meta_description: A compact, functional herb garden supporting medicinal and culinary use while showcasing varied growing conditions in a small space.

frontmatter.description: Replacing a traditional, lawn-heavy front yard with a pollinator-friendly garden that feels welcoming, intentional, and manageable.
frontmatter.goal: The homeowner wanted to replace a traditional, lawn-heavy front yard with a pollinator-friendly garden that still felt welcoming, intentional, and manageable.
frontmatter.challenges: Full sun exposure and compacted soil. Desire for native plants without an overgrown look. Low-maintenance expectations.
frontmatter.solution: I designed a layered planting plan using native perennials, ornamental grasses, and flowering plants chosen for long bloom periods and habitat value. The design followed a 'right plant, right place' approach to ensure long-term success and seasonal interest.
frontmatter.outcome: The garden now supports bees, butterflies, and birds throughout the growing season while remaining visually cohesive and approachable. The client gained confidence maintaining the space and plans to expand the garden over time.

frontmatter.quote: Sarah has a way of really listening to what you want. The garden she designed exceeded our expectations, creating a space that feels both beautiful and alive with pollinators and birds. We treasure it every day.

Hiring Sarah was one of the best decisions we made for our yard. Not only was her work incredibly thoughtful and ecological, but she made us feel confident and excited about gardening for the first time.

Sarah was always available to answer our questions, offer plant recommendations, and ensure everything thrived. Her dedication to creating a sustainable garden was evident in every detail, and we are grateful for her beautiful work.
